name: receipt-ledger
description: Accounting AI — multi-account books with local receipt extract
author: Accounting AI

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n server,electron -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173/api/health && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.electron:pack: npm run build && npm run electron:bundle
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run electron:pack && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac zip --x64 --arm64
scripts.electron:build:mac:dmg: npm run electron:pack && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --arm64
scripts.electron:build:desktop: npm run electron:pack && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win portable --x64 --mac zip --x64 --arm64
